concept.title: LoRA Adapter Effect
concept.answer: A LoRA adapter changes what a model says by adding small trainable low-rank matrices to selected weights, steering outputs toward a style, task or knowledge without fully retraining the base model.

items.label: Low-rank update
items.detail: Adds trainable A and B matrices to frozen weights to change activations.

items.label: Output steering
items.detail: Biases generations toward a specific style, tone or task learned during adapter training.

items.label: Parameter efficient
items.detail: Base model stays frozen so the adapter can be swapped in and out.

items.label: Composable
items.detail: Multiple adapters can be loaded to mix behaviors while keeping the core model unchanged.
